title: The Right Time
content:
It was in the summer of 2024 when Sophia first met Daniel.

They met at a small café near the university on a rainy Friday afternoon. Sophia had gone there to escape the rain, and Daniel was sitting alone near the window, reading a book.

When Sophia entered the café, she realized that there were no empty tables. Daniel noticed her and offered her a seat.

— Would you like to sit here? — he asked.

Sophia smiled and said yes.

They began talking, and before they knew it, several hours had passed. Sophia found Daniel funny and intelligent, while Daniel thought Sophia was different from anyone he had ever met.

In the following weeks, they saw each other many times. They went to museums, ate dinner at small restaurants, and took long walks through the city.

On weekends, they usually explored new places together. One Saturday, Daniel bought two tickets for a concert. Sophia was surprised because she had mentioned her favorite band only once.

— You remembered? — she asked.

— Of course — Daniel said. — I heard you talking about them.

The concert started at eight o'clock on Saturday night. During their favorite song, Daniel looked at Sophia and suddenly understood something. He had fallen in love with her.

However, life became complicated in September when Sophia received an opportunity to study abroad. She had to leave the city for six months.

They promised to stay in touch, but being far away was difficult. They wrote messages, spoke on the phone, and sent each other photographs.

At times, Sophia wondered if their relationship would survive the distance. Daniel felt the same way, but neither of them wanted to give up.

Then, on a cold evening in December, Sophia received an unexpected letter.

Daniel had written it several weeks before.

The letter said:

— I know that distance has changed many things, but it hasn't changed how I feel about you. I met you on a rainy afternoon, and since that day, my life has become more beautiful. I don't know what will happen in the future, but I know that I want to be there with you.

Sophia read the letter again at midnight.

A few months later, she finally returned home. Daniel was waiting for her at the airport.

When she saw him, Sophia ran toward him, and he held her tightly.

They had spent months apart, but at that moment, they both knew that some things were worth waiting for.

Sometimes, the most important stories begin in unexpected moments, on ordinary days, and at exactly the right time.
